<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">The content collection is similar; however, Team Plan is designed for small teams and doesn't include:</p>

<ul class="wp-block-list">

"}},{"@type":"Question","name": "What content is included with Udemy Business plans?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type": "Answer","text": "
<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73;font-size:18px;line-height:1.3">Udemy Business provides access to content created by <strong>real-world practitioners</strong> across AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity, data science, leadership and management, project and product management, software development, and programming.</p>
"}},{"@type":"Question","name": "What features are available for learners and admins in the Enterprise Plan?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type": "Answer","text": "
<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73;font-size:18px;line-height:1.3">The Udemy Business Enterprise Plan offers advanced features designed to develop organization-wide skills at scale with measurable impact. These include:</p>

<ul class="wp-block-list">

















</ul>
"}},{"@type":"Question","name": "Does Udemy Business include AI and generative AI training?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type": "Answer","text": "
<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>Yes</strong>. Udemy Business supports end-to-end AI learning, from foundational concepts to advanced, role-specific, and enterprise transformation topics.</p>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">The <strong>Team Plan</strong> and <strong>Enterprise Plan</strong> include content beyond AI:</p>

<ul style="color:#6a6f73" class="wp-block-list has-text-color has-link-color">

</ul>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">These plans are ideal for organizations seeking a comprehensive learning solution that goes beyond AI to address a wide range of skill development needs.</p>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">For organizations focused solely on AI learning, Udemy Business offers two tailored base plans:</p>

<ul class="wp-block-list">

</ul>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">Both AI-specific plans are designed to deliver fast, focused AI learning outcomes, while the Team and Enterprise Plans provide a broader, organization-wide learning solution that includes AI and much more.</p>
"}},{"@type":"Question","name": "What analytics and reporting does Udemy Business provide?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type": "Answer","text": "
<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">Udemy Business offers analytics to track learner adoption, engagement, and skill development.</p>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">The <strong>Enterprise Plan </strong>unlocks advanced dashboards, skill insights, course performance data, and reporting for labs and assessments (with the Udemy Business Pro add-on), helping organizations measure real learning impact.</p>
"}},{"@type":"Question","name": "Can Udemy Business integrate with our LMS or HR systems?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type": "Answer","text": "
<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>Yes</strong>, the <strong>Udemy Business Enterprise Plan</strong> supports single sign-on (SSO), LMS and LXP integrations, APIs (user, course, and reporting), and workplace tools such as Slack.</p>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>Yes</strong>, the <strong>Udemy Business Enterprise Plan </strong>supports single sign-on (SSO), LMS and LXP integrations, APIs (user, course, and reporting), and workplace tools such as Slack.</p>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">We also offer <strong>AI Connectors</strong> as an add-on to Enterprise Plan customers.</p>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">As an early adopter of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), <strong>AI Connectors</strong> enable AI agents to work together, delivering personalized learning experiences in the flow of work, tailored to your specific business context and data.</p>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">These integrations allow learning to fit seamlessly into existing systems and workflows and are only available to Enterprise Plan customers.</p>
"}},{"@type":"Question","name": "Can employees learn in languages other than English?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type": "Answer","text": "
<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>Yes.</strong> Enterprise Plan customers get access to a multi-language course collection with 53% of the courses in non-English languages, including Arabic, English, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Mandarin, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, and Vietnamese.</p>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">Japanese and Korean collections are available as premium add-ons for an extra charge.</p>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">This enables global teams to learn in their local language while maintaining consistent skill standards.</p>
"}},{"@type":"Question","name": "What are the key add-ons available for Udemy Business?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type": "Answer","text": "
<ul class="wp-block-list">





</ul>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color" style="color:#6a6f73">​​Add-ons are available for an additional fee and are not included in the base plan price.</p>

			// Promo bar dismissal. Positioning is entirely CSS now - see
			// assets/sass/Elements/promo-bar.scss and the sticky mobile
			// .site-header in new-custom.scss / critical/fullwidth.scss.
			const promoBar = document.getElementById('promo-bar');
			// Self-contained (no dependency on assets/events/js/_scripts.js or any
			// webpack-bundled JS - those only load on SOME templates, not this one
			// reliably; e.g. the 'fullwidth' template has no dist/ bundle of its
			// own at all). Reads/writes the same hidePromoBar cookie, a
			// space-separated list of dismissed bars' TRIDs (WPML translation-group
			// IDs - the one identifier that's identical across every language
			// version of the same bar).
			function getDismissedPromoBarTrids() {
				var match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)hidePromoBar=([^;]*)/);
				return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : '';
			}

			function setDismissedPromoBarTrids(value) {
				var d = new Date();
				d.setTime(d.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 1 day
				document.cookie = 'hidePromoBar=' + encodeURIComponent(value) +
					'; expires=' + d.toUTCString() + '; path=/; SameSite=Lax' +
					(location.protocol === 'https:' ? '; Secure' : '');
			}

			// Whether THIS visitor already dismissed THIS bar is decided here,
			// client-side, as the very first thing this script does - not by the
			// server (see the comment above ub_get_active_promo_bar_html()'s return
			// in this same file for why: WP Engine's edge cache serves one shared
			// cached response to every visitor, deciding before PHP ever runs, so a
			// per-visitor server-side check has no effect on most requests). Runs
			// synchronously, before the browser paints this part of the page, so a
			// returning/dismissed visitor never sees the bar appear at all.
			if (promoBar && promoBar.dataset.promoTrid &&
				getDismissedPromoBarTrids().indexOf(promoBar.dataset.promoTrid) !== -1) {
				promoBar.style.display = 'none';
				var siteHeaderInit = document.querySelector('.site-header');
				if (siteHeaderInit) siteHeaderInit.classList.remove('has-promo-bar');
			}

			// Hide banner function
			function hideBanner() {
				if (promoBar) {
					promoBar.style.display = 'none';
					if (promoBar.dataset.promoTrid) {
						var existing = getDismissedPromoBarTrids();
						setDismissedPromoBarTrids(
							existing ? existing + ' ' + promoBar.dataset.promoTrid : promoBar.dataset.promoTrid
						);
					}
				}
				// Desktop: shrink the server-rendered spacer back down (see
				// header.php's has-promo-bar class, and style.css's
				// .site-header.has-promo-bar rule). This is a legitimate,
				// user-triggered "fall into place" moment - the CSS
				// transition on .site-header animates it smoothly - unlike
				// a load-time timing race, since it's a direct response to
				// the user's own click.
				var siteHeader = document.querySelector('.site-header');
				if (siteHeader) siteHeader.classList.remove('has-promo-bar');
			}

<div class="wp-block-jarvis-spacer aligncenter jv-block-spacer-_145bd1-9b"><div class="jv-block-spacer jv-block-spacer-halign-center" style="height:30px"></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-jarvis-accordion alignnone plan-accordion faq-accordion"><div class="jv-accordion-wrap jv-accordion-wrap jv-accordion-id_bdc96a-ca jv-accordion-has-17-panes jv-active-pane-0 jv-accordion-block jv-pane-header-alignment-left jv-accodion-icon-style-arrow jv-accodion-icon-side-right  " style="max-width:none"><div class="jv-accordion-inner-wrap" data-allow-multiple-open="false" data-start-open="0">
<div class="wp-block-jarvis-pane jv-accordion-pane jv-accordion-pane-5 jv-pane_e25079-1b"><div class="jv-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="jv-blocks-accordion-header jv-acccordion-button-label-show"><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-title">What’s the difference between the Udemy Business Team Plan and Enterprise Plan?</span></span><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="jv-accordion-panel"><div class="jv-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-b2ffb29bf4fc0b37643b40d077923bfc" style="color:#6a6f73">The content collection is similar; however, Team Plan is designed for small teams and doesn’t include:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-345ed4e61eb777045d23c373d69c4a0f" style="color:#6a6f73">Single Sign-On (SSO) integration</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-6d6496c3bed6e5f6272a5c6a9f623e0f" style="color:#6a6f73">Advanced administrative and user management capabilities</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-3e51031fead927b3fdef52d18cdca906" style="color:#6a6f73">Enterprise system integrations (LMS, HRIS, etc.)</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-8d00e577d25e2425a890f91f1bbd39f3" style="color:#6a6f73">Access to paid add-on features (AI Connectors, AI Role Play, and premium content collections in additional languages such as Japanese or Korean)</li>
</ul>
</div></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-jarvis-pane jv-accordion-pane jv-accordion-pane-4 jv-pane_5d50f3-50"><div class="jv-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="jv-blocks-accordion-header jv-acccordion-button-label-show"><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-title">What content is included with Udemy Business plans?</span></span><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="jv-accordion-panel"><div class="jv-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-1865d2d205c14de8d0239eaa28e8704a" style="color:#6a6f73;font-size:18px;line-height:1.3">Udemy Business provides access to content created by <strong>real-world practitioners</strong> across AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity, data science, leadership and management, project and product management, software development, and programming.</p>
</div></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-jarvis-pane jv-accordion-pane jv-accordion-pane-6 jv-pane_2387e4-75"><div class="jv-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="jv-blocks-accordion-header jv-acccordion-button-label-show"><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-title">What features are available for learners and admins in the Enterprise Plan?</span></span><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="jv-accordion-panel"><div class="jv-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-639d011579d6b658758ba6040a3f22b8" style="color:#6a6f73;font-size:18px;line-height:1.3">The Udemy Business Enterprise Plan offers advanced features designed to develop organization-wide skills at scale with measurable impact. These include:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-c7c22fde1b660170be67dfbad20832b7" style="color:#6a6f73">In-course AI Assistant for personalized learning support</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-700f242bc6333047fde4536f82a47629" style="color:#6a6f73">6,000+ AI Role Plays to practice real-world scenarios with interactive, AI-powered simulations</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-ecf9dcb3f372608e4c24981bbf1bafb2" style="color:#6a6f73">500+ skills assessments to identify gaps and align learning with business goals</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-eb0062e58c5458a399a0ed605929f555" style="color:#6a6f73">Goal-focused learning recommendations tailored to individual needs</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-c275db7db7776b740cef1c70af46e438" style="color:#6a6f73">Admin recommendations to guide learners at scale with curated content</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-17d12d702902349b543dc01ba895cff6" style="color:#6a6f73">Skills Mapping and AI-Powered Learning Paths, curated AI paths, and in-course labs for hands-on practice.</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-388926753b7a6bd7d6fdc3eb36c5b0fc" style="color:#6a6f73">Certification prep for over 300 exams</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-3612ea750da8889e58a1bd31a02da958" style="color:#6a6f73">AI-powered coding exercises and practice tests</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-25a0bee3fd9133a94e55774670c1f7c6" style="color:#6a6f73">Create custom content and learning paths</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-519e81a0617096a02b9de2765ceed6f6" style="color:#6a6f73">Analytics and adoption reports</li>
</ul>
</div></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-jarvis-pane jv-accordion-pane jv-accordion-pane-7 jv-pane_2423b5-e0"><div class="jv-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="jv-blocks-accordion-header jv-acccordion-button-label-show"><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-title">Does Udemy Business include AI and generative AI training?</span></span><span class="jv-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="jv-accordion-panel"><div class="jv-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-e9425976b9dfb6d9a4d11190234acb72" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>Yes</strong>. Udemy Business supports end-to-end AI learning, from foundational concepts to advanced, role-specific, and enterprise transformation topics.</p>



<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-def6ac9c11ded64b84e42b3e5d1b0fcb" style="color:#6a6f73">The <strong>Team Plan</strong> and <strong>Enterprise Plan</strong> include content beyond AI:</p>



<ul style="color:#6a6f73" class="wp-block-list has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-3dc2f0173f6adb578db2d012a846b09c">
<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-7eca74aebadb9fb7e5fa6b2b2695f5c3" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>Team Plan:</strong> Offers access to 28,000+ courses across business, technology, leadership, and more, along with curated AI and machine learning courses for introductory and intermediate skill levels.</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-10d3ce780b36edc2e93d5f769256e86d" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>Enterprise Plan: </strong>Provides full access to the entire Udemy Business catalog, including 30,000+ courses spanning AI, business, technology, leadership, compliance, and more. This plan also includes advanced features such as multilingual content, teach functionality for creating custom content, assessments, customizable learning paths, and advanced analytics.</li>
</ul>



<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-925193655d573e84fdd70c96525161bc" style="color:#6a6f73">These plans are ideal for organizations seeking a comprehensive learning solution that goes beyond AI to address a wide range of skill development needs.</p>



<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-d69a3ab72bbbcf0814c00ac0b8144b25" style="color:#6a6f73">For organizations focused solely on AI learning, Udemy Business offers two tailored base plans:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-e1182f50c7a014c03b26f70e519f2c36" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>AI Readiness Plan: </strong>Designed for foundational AI literacy across broad workforces, this plan includes a curated collection of 45-50 AI courses (available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese), AI topic assessments (new in Q2 2026!), and starter learning paths. Ideal for large groups, the plan requires a minimum of 100 seats.</li>



<li class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-c24047ff262ddbb2dbc246abc52d0dc9" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>AI Growth Plan: </strong>Focused on advanced AI development for targeted teams, this plan features a larger course collection, curated role-specific and technology paths, in-course AI topic assessments (new in Q2, 2026!), and hands-on practice opportunities. With multi-language support across 14 languages, it’s designed for smaller, focused cohorts with a minimum of 21 seats.</li>
</ul>



<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-f82b49efb30ad362fc5030319daaf0d4" style="color:#6a6f73">Both AI-specific plans are designed to deliver fast, focused AI learning outcomes, while the Team and Enterprise Plans provide a broader, organization-wide learning solution that includes AI and much more.</p>
</div></div></div>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-24fd3cd6f6f2776290fe73df97563bd5" style="color:#6a6f73">Udemy Business offers analytics to track learner adoption, engagement, and skill development.</p>



<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-d9f072316b9e94051088e081a6f09acc" style="color:#6a6f73">The <strong>Enterprise Plan </strong>unlocks advanced dashboards, skill insights, course performance data, and reporting for labs and assessments (with the Udemy Business Pro add-on), helping organizations measure real learning impact.</p>
</div></div></div>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-b203e270a95fd332cfd7ca9881b02357" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>Yes</strong>, the <strong>Udemy Business Enterprise Plan</strong> supports single sign-on (SSO), LMS and LXP integrations, APIs (user, course, and reporting), and workplace tools such as Slack.</p>



<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-20d3997e6f042d19f38db349c6783aca" style="color:#6a6f73"><strong>Yes</strong>, the <strong>Udemy Business Enterprise Plan </strong>supports single sign-on (SSO), LMS and LXP integrations, APIs (user, course, and reporting), and workplace tools such as Slack.</p>



<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-eda4860a07761c08b483079633e0bc9d" style="color:#6a6f73">We also offer <strong>AI Connectors</strong> as an add-on to Enterprise Plan customers.</p>



<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-f0b69d8ef82252f6bb3e0323cba92f7a" style="color:#6a6f73">As an early adopter of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), <strong>AI Connectors</strong> enable AI agents to work together, delivering personalized learning experiences in the flow of work, tailored to your specific business context and data.</p>



<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-729b7bb4c397e2ce3255fae7cdccda7c" style="color:#6a6f73">These integrations allow learning to fit seamlessly into existing systems and workflows and are only available to Enterprise Plan customers.</p>

<p class="has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-7025cd3c3f517cc42866c7fcbcddd08c" style="color:#6a6f73">Japanese and Korean collections are available as premium add-ons for an extra charge.</p>

	<script>
		(function () {
			"use strict";

			const PILL_ROW_SELECTOR = '.blog-category-pills-wrapper .blog-category-pills';

			function isMobile() {
				return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)').matches;
			}

			function enableDragScroll(viewport) {
				if (!viewport) return;

				// Prevent double-binding
				if (viewport.dataset.dragScrollBound === "1") return;
				viewport.dataset.dragScrollBound = "1";

				let isDown = false;
				let startX = 0;
				let startScrollLeft = 0;
				let didDrag = false;

				// Cursor affordance on desktop
				viewport.style.cursor = 'grab';

				function getPageX(e) {
					if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) return e.touches[0].pageX;
					if (typeof e.pageX === 'number') return e.pageX;
					return 0;
				}

				function onDown(e) {
					// Only left mouse button (ignore right click)
					if (typeof e.button !== 'undefined' && e.button !== 0) return;

					isDown = true;
					didDrag = false;
					startX = getPageX(e);
					startScrollLeft = viewport.scrollLeft;

					viewport.style.cursor = 'grabbing';

					// Keep receiving pointer events
					if (viewport.setPointerCapture && e.pointerId != null) {
						try { viewport.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
					}
				}

				function onMove(e) {
					if (!isDown) return;

					const x = getPageX(e);
					const walk = x - startX;

					// Threshold before treating as drag
					if (Math.abs(walk) > 6) didDrag = true;

					viewport.scrollLeft = startScrollLeft - walk;
				}

				function onUp() {
					if (!isDown) return;
					isDown = false;
					viewport.style.cursor = 'grab';
					// NOTE: do not reset didDrag here; it's used to decide tap vs drag
				}

				// Pointer events cover mouse + touch well
				viewport.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
					// If the user started on a pill link, let the link be clickable
					if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a')) return;
					onDown(e);
				}, { passive: true });

				viewport.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove, { passive: true });

				viewport.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp, { passive: true });
				viewport.addEventListener('pointercancel', onUp, { passive: true });
				viewport.addEventListener('pointerleave', onUp, { passive: true });

				// ✅ Tap-to-navigate fix (works even when click target resolves to viewport/container)
				viewport.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) {
					const a = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.blog-category-pills a.blog-pill');
					if (!a) return;

					// If the user dragged, do not navigate
					if (didDrag) return;

					// Let modified clicks behave normally (cmd/ctrl open new tab, etc.)
					if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;

					window.location.href = a.href;
				}, { passive: true });
			}

			function updateNav(nav) {
				if (!nav) return;

				const viewport = nav.querySelector('.blog-pill-nav__viewport');
				const left = nav.querySelector('.blog-pill-nav__arrow--left');
				const right = nav.querySelector('.blog-pill-nav__arrow--right');
				if (!viewport || !left || !right) return;

				// Only show/use arrows on mobile (but drag still works fine on desktop)
				if (!isMobile()) {
					nav.classList.remove('has-overflow');
					left.disabled = true;
					right.disabled = true;
					return;
				}

				const overflow = viewport.scrollWidth > (viewport.clientWidth + 1);
				nav.classList.toggle('has-overflow', overflow);

				if (!overflow) {
					left.disabled = true;
					right.disabled = true;
					return;
				}

				const max = viewport.scrollWidth - viewport.clientWidth;
				left.disabled = viewport.scrollLeft <= 1;
				right.disabled = viewport.scrollLeft >= (max - 1);
			}

			function initPillNav() {
				const pills = document.querySelector(PILL_ROW_SELECTOR);
				if (!pills) return;

				// Already enhanced? just update state
				const existingNav = pills.closest('.blog-pill-nav');
				if (existingNav) {
					updateNav(existingNav);
					return;
				}

				// Build structure:
				// <div class="blog-pill-nav">
				//   <button left>
				//   <div class="blog-pill-nav__viewport">
				//      (your existing .blog-category-pills moved here)
				//   </div>
				//   <button right>
				// </div>

				const nav = document.createElement('div');
				nav.className = 'blog-pill-nav';

				const left = document.createElement('button');
				left.type = 'button';
				left.className = 'blog-pill-nav__arrow blog-pill-nav__arrow--left';
				left.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Scroll categories left');
				left.innerHTML = '<span aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left"></i></span>';

				const right = document.createElement('button');
				right.type = 'button';
				right.className = 'blog-pill-nav__arrow blog-pill-nav__arrow--right';
				right.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Scroll categories right');
				right.innerHTML = '<span aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i></span>';

				const viewport = document.createElement('div');
				viewport.className = 'blog-pill-nav__viewport';

				// Enable click/drag scroll + tap-to-navigate
				enableDragScroll(viewport);

				// Insert nav where pills currently are
				const wrapper = pills.parentNode;
				wrapper.insertBefore(nav, pills);

				viewport.appendChild(pills);
				nav.appendChild(left);
				nav.appendChild(viewport);
				nav.appendChild(right);

				function scrollByChunk(dir) {
					const amt = Math.round(viewport.clientWidth * 0.8);
					viewport.scrollBy({ left: dir * amt, behavior: 'smooth' });
				}

				left.addEventListener('click', function(){
					if (left.disabled) return;
					scrollByChunk(-1);
				});

				right.addEventListener('click', function(){
					if (right.disabled) return;
					scrollByChunk(1);
				});

				viewport.addEventListener('scroll', function(){
					// throttle via rAF
					if (viewport.__pillRAF) return;
					viewport.__pillRAF = requestAnimationFrame(function(){
						viewport.__pillRAF = null;
						updateNav(nav);
					});
				});

				window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
					updateNav(nav);
				});

				// Initial update (and after layout settles)
				updateNav(nav);
				setTimeout(() => updateNav(nav), 250);
				setTimeout(() => updateNav(nav), 1000);
			}

			// Init
			if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
				document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initPillNav);
			} else {
				initPillNav();
			}

			// If S&F (or other AJAX) re-renders pills later, call again safely
			document.addEventListener('sf:ajaxfinish', initPillNav, true);

		})();

		<script>
		(function () {
			"use strict";

			function qs(sel, root){ return (root || document).querySelector(sel); }
			function qsa(sel, root){ return Array.from((root || document).querySelectorAll(sel)); }

			function getBlogSearchForm(root = document) {
				return qs('.sf-ui--bloghome-pills form.searchandfilter[id^="search-filter-form-"]', root);
			}

			function getResultsRoots(root = document) {
				return qsa('.search-filter-results[id^="search-filter-results-"]', root);
			}

			function getPrimaryResultsRoot(root = document) {
				const roots = getResultsRoots(root);
				if (!roots.length) return null;

				for (const el of roots) {
					if (
						el.querySelector('.pagination, nav.pagination, [class*="pagination"]') ||
						el.querySelector('.sf-result, article, li, .sf-grid-item, .sf-card, .wp-block-post')
					) {
						return el;
					}
				}

				return roots[0];
			}

			function getResultsId(resultsRoot) {
				if (!resultsRoot || !resultsRoot.id) return '';
				return resultsRoot.id.replace('search-filter-results-', '');
			}

			function getButtonId(resultsRoot) {
				return 'ufb-sf-show-more-' + getResultsId(resultsRoot);
			}

			function findPaginationRoot(root) {
				return qs('.pagination', root) || qs('nav.pagination', root) || qs('[class*="pagination"]', root);
			}

			function findNextUrl(root) {
				const pag = findPaginationRoot(root);
				if (!pag) return '';

				const next =
					qs('a.next', pag) ||
					qs('a[rel="next"]', pag) ||
					qs('.nav-previous a', pag) || // WP: next_posts_link() (older/higher page) lives in .nav-previous, not .nav-next
					qs('a', pag);

				return next && next.href ? next.href : '';
			}

			function pickMainResultsContainer(resultsRoot) {
				const candidates = [
					'.sf-results-container',
					'.sf-blog-home-results',
					'.sf-grid-results-container',
					'.sf-results',
					'.results',
					'ul',
					'div'
				];

				let best = null;
				let bestScore = 0;

				for (const sel of candidates) {
					const els = qsa(sel, resultsRoot);

					for (const el of els) {
						if (el.closest('.pagination') || el.querySelector('.pagination')) continue;

						const directChildren = el.children ? el.children.length : 0;
						const cardish = qsa('.sf-result, article, li, .sf-grid-item, .sf-card, .wp-block-post', el).length;
						const score = directChildren + cardish;

						if (score > bestScore) {
							bestScore = score;
							best = el;
						}
					}
				}

				return best || resultsRoot;
			}

			function removePaginationFrom(containerEl) {
				const pag = findPaginationRoot(containerEl);
				if (pag) pag.remove();
			}

			function ensureButton() {
				const form = getBlogSearchForm(document);
				const resultsRoot = getPrimaryResultsRoot(document);

				if (!form || !resultsRoot) return;

				const btnId = getButtonId(resultsRoot);

				const old = document.getElementById(btnId);
				if (old) old.remove();

				const nextUrl = findNextUrl(resultsRoot);
				if (!nextUrl) return;

				const pag = findPaginationRoot(resultsRoot);
				if (pag) pag.style.display = 'none';

				const btn = document.createElement('button');
				btn.type = 'button';
				btn.id = btnId;
				btn.className = 'btn secondary-button sf-show-more-results';
				btn.textContent = 'Show more';
				btn.dataset.nextUrl = nextUrl;

				resultsRoot.parentNode.insertBefore(btn, resultsRoot.nextSibling);

				btn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
					const url = btn.dataset.nextUrl;
					if (!url) return;

					btn.disabled = true;
					const prevText = btn.textContent;
					btn.textContent = 'Loading…';

					try {
						const res = await fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin' });
						if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);

						const html = await res.text();
						const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');

						const nextForm = getBlogSearchForm(doc);
						const nextRoot = getPrimaryResultsRoot(doc);

						if (!nextForm || !nextRoot) {
							throw new Error('Next form/results root not found in response');
						}

						const currentMain = pickMainResultsContainer(resultsRoot);
						const nextMain = pickMainResultsContainer(nextRoot);

						removePaginationFrom(nextMain);

						const nodesToAppend = Array.from(nextMain.children || []);
						if (!nodesToAppend.length) {
							currentMain.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', nextMain.innerHTML);
						} else {
							nodesToAppend.forEach(node => {
								currentMain.appendChild(node.cloneNode(true));
							});
						}

						const nextUrl2 = findNextUrl(nextRoot);
						if (nextUrl2) {
							btn.dataset.nextUrl = nextUrl2;
							btn.disabled = false;
							btn.textContent = prevText;
						} else {
							btn.textContent = 'No more results';
							btn.disabled = true;
						}

					} catch (e) {
						console.error('[UFB S&F Show More] error:', e);
						btn.textContent = prevText;
						btn.disabled = false;
					}
				});
			}

			ensureButton();
			document.addEventListener('sf:ajaxfinish', function(){ ensureButton(); }, true);

		})();
	</script>
